# Overview

This script performs the Difference-in-Discontinuities analysis comparing state-owned vs independent media responses to the invasion, using time as a continuous running variable instead of by day. Articles without publication times are dropped as a robustness check.

**Inputs:**
- `data/intermediate/02_data_non_ukraine.rds`
- `data/intermediate/02_cleaned_data.rds`

**Outputs:**
- Diff-in-disc regression results (continuous, drop no-time articles)
- Visualizations
- Table 2F

```{r setup-drop, include=FALSE}
source("00_setup.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(FIGURES_DIFF_DISC_DROP, "/"))
```

# Load Data

```{r load-drop}
data_non_ukraine <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "02_data_non_ukraine.rds"))
data <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "02_cleaned_data.rds"))

data_non_ukraine <- data_non_ukraine %>% filter(has_time == TRUE)
cat("Non-Ukraine sample after dropping no-time articles:", nrow(data_non_ukraine), "articles\n")

data <- data %>% filter(has_time == TRUE)
cat("Full sample after dropping no-time articles:", nrow(data), "articles\n")

cat("State-owned:", sum(data_non_ukraine$state_owned), "\n")
cat("Independent:", sum(data_non_ukraine$state_owned == 0), "\n")
```

# Main Diff-in-Disc Model

## Model 2a: Full Triple Interaction

```{r model2a-drop}
model2a <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned | country + topic_clean | 0 | source_domain,
                data = data_non_ukraine)

summary(model2a)
```

## Effect Size Analysis

```{r effect-size-discs-drop}
sd_sentiment_non_ukraine <- sd(data_non_ukraine$sentiment_clean)

cat("Standard deviation:", round(sd_sentiment_non_ukraine, 3), "\n\n")

# Effect on all media
coef_all <- summary(model2a)$coef["treatment", "Estimate"]
cat("Effect on all media (in SD):", round(coef_all / sd_sentiment_non_ukraine, 3), "\n")

# Effect on state media specifically
coef_state <- summary(model2a)$coef["treatment:state_owned", "Estimate"]
cat("Additional effect on state media (in SD):", round(coef_state / sd_sentiment_non_ukraine, 3), "\n")
```

# Visualization: Main Diff-in-Disc Plot

```{r plot-discs-cont-drop, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# Aggregate data
agg_data_discs <- data_non_ukraine %>%
  group_by(running_continuous, state_owned) %>%
  summarize(
    sentiment_clean = mean(sentiment_clean, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

invasion_discs_graph <- data_non_ukraine %>%
  mutate(indicator = as.factor(indicator)) %>%
  mutate(indicator = fct_recode(indicator,
    "Ind. Pre." = "1",
    "State Pre." = "2",
    "Ind. Post" = "3",
    "State Post" = "4"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = running_continuous, y = sentiment_clean, group = indicator, color = indicator)) +
  geom_point(data = agg_data_discs,
             aes(x = running_continuous, y = sentiment_clean, size = num_obs),
             alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_color_manual(values = COLORS_DISCS, name = "Source Type") +
  scale_size(name = "Observations") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Invasion on Sentiment (Continuous, Drop No-Time Articles)",
    subtitle = "Difference in Discontinuities",
    x = "Hours Pre/Post Invasion",
    y = "Sentiment"
  )

invasion_discs_graph

ggsave(plot = invasion_discs_graph,
       file.path(FIGURES_DIFF_DISC_DROP, "invasion_discs_graph_cont_drop.png"),
       width = 10, height = 7)
```

# Optimal Bandwidth Selection

```{r optimal-bw-drop}
data_non_ukraine <- data_non_ukraine %>%
  mutate(across(c("country", "source_domain", "topic_clean"), as.factor))

#covs_matrix <- model.matrix(~ country + topic_clean + state_owned - 1, data = data_non_ukraine)

bw_select <- rdbwselect(y = data_non_ukraine$sentiment_clean,
                        x = data_non_ukraine$running_continuous,
                        #covs = covs_matrix,
                        kernel = "triangular",
                        cluster = data_non_ukraine$source_domain,
                        p = 1,
                        bwselect = "mserd")

summary(bw_select)

optimal_bw <- bw_select$bws[1, 1]
cat("Optimal bandwidth:", round(optimal_bw, 1), "seconds\n")

optimal_bandwidth_data <- data_non_ukraine %>%
  filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw) %>%
  filter(running_continuous > -optimal_bw)

cat("Observations within bandwidth:", nrow(optimal_bandwidth_data), "\n")
```

## Model with Optimal Bandwidth

```{r model2a-opt-drop}
model2a_opt <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned | country + topic_clean | 0 | source_domain,
                    data = optimal_bandwidth_data)

summary(model2a_opt)
```

data_cult <- data_non_ukraine %>% filter(topic_clean == "Culture")

model2a_full_pol <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned | country | 0 | source_domain,
                         data = data_pol)
model2a_full_mil <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned | country | 0 | source_domain,

model2a_full_cult <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned | country | 0 | source_domain,
                          data = data_cult)

## Per-Topic Optimal Bandwidth

```{r topic-opt-bw-drop}
# Political
bw_pol <- rdbwselect(y = data_pol$sentiment_clean, x = data_pol$running_continuous,
                     kernel = "triangular", cluster = data_pol$source_domain, p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
optimal_bw_pol <- bw_pol$bws[1, 1]
cat("Political optimal bandwidth:", round(optimal_bw_pol, 1), "seconds\n")
opt_data_pol <- data_pol %>% filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw_pol, running_continuous > -optimal_bw_pol)

# Military
bw_mil <- rdbwselect(y = data_mil$sentiment_clean, x = data_mil$running_continuous,
                     kernel = "triangular", cluster = data_mil$source_domain, p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
optimal_bw_mil <- bw_mil$bws[1, 1]
cat("Military optimal bandwidth:", round(optimal_bw_mil, 1), "seconds\n")
opt_data_mil <- data_mil %>% filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw_mil, running_continuous > -optimal_bw_mil)

# Economic
bw_econ <- rdbwselect(y = data_econ$sentiment_clean, x = data_econ$running_continuous,
                      kernel = "triangular", cluster = data_econ$source_domain, p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
optimal_bw_econ <- bw_econ$bws[1, 1]
cat("Economic optimal bandwidth:", round(optimal_bw_econ, 1), "seconds\n")
opt_data_econ <- data_econ %>% filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw_econ, running_continuous > -optimal_bw_econ)

# Culture
bw_cult <- rdbwselect(y = data_cult$sentiment_clean, x = data_cult$running_continuous,
                      kernel = "triangular", cluster = data_cult$source_domain, p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
optimal_bw_cult <- bw_cult$bws[1, 1]
cat("Culture optimal bandwidth:", round(optimal_bw_cult, 1), "seconds\n")
opt_data_cult <- data_cult %>% filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw_cult, running_continuous > -optimal_bw_cult)

# Other
bw_oth <- rdbwselect(y = data_oth$sentiment_clean, x = data_oth$running_continuous,
                     kernel = "triangular", cluster = data_oth$source_domain, p = 1, bwselect = "mserd")
optimal_bw_oth <- bw_oth$bws[1, 1]
cat("Other optimal bandwidth:", round(optimal_bw_oth, 1), "seconds\n")
opt_data_oth <- data_oth %>% filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw_oth, running_continuous > -optimal_bw_oth)
```

# Robustness: Combined Filter with Re-Optimized Bandwidth

```{r combined-robust-drop}
data_combined_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(!Russian.Involvement == "Not") %>%
  filter(!country %in% c("Ukraine")) %>%
  filter(!country %in% NATO_COUNTRIES) %>%
  filter(!topic_clean %in% c("Military"))

data_combined_filtered <- data_combined_filtered %>%
  mutate(across(c("country", "source_domain", "topic_clean"), as.factor))

bw_select_combined <- rdbwselect(y = data_combined_filtered$sentiment_clean,
                                  x = data_combined_filtered$running_continuous,
                                  kernel = "triangular",
                                  cluster = data_combined_filtered$source_domain,
                                  p = 1,
                                  bwselect = "mserd")

summary(bw_select_combined)

optimal_bw_combined <- bw_select_combined$bws[1, 1]
```


```{r combined-robust-model-drop}
cat("Optimal bandwidth (combined filter):", round(optimal_bw_combined, 1), "seconds\n")

optimal_bw_combined_data <- data_combined_filtered %>%
  filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw_combined) %>%
  filter(running_continuous > -optimal_bw_combined)

cat("Observations within bandwidth:", nrow(optimal_bw_combined_data), "\n")

model3a_opt <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned | country + topic_clean | 0 | source_domain,
                    data = optimal_bw_combined_data)

summary(model3a_opt)

# Saturated Model
model3a_opt_saturated <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned |
                          source_domain:topic_clean + country:state_owned + country:topic_clean:treatment |
                          0 | source_domain,
                          data = optimal_bw_combined_data)

summary(model3a_opt_saturated)
```

summary(model_did)

# Placebo Test: December 7th Announcement (with Optimal Bandwidth)

```{r placebo-drop}
data_dec <- data %>%
  filter(date_publish < "2022-02-19") %>%
  mutate(
    running_continuous = as.numeric(difftime(date_publish_continuous, as.POSIXct("2021-12-07 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"), units = "secs")),
    treatment = ifelse(date_publish_continuous < as.POSIXct("2021-12-07 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"), 0, 1)
  )

# Find optimal bandwidth for placebo
bw_placebo <- rdbwselect(y = data_dec$sentiment_clean,
                         x = data_dec$running_continuous,
                         kernel = "triangular",
                         cluster = data_dec$source_domain,
                         p = 1,
                         bwselect = "mserd")

optimal_bw_placebo <- bw_placebo$bws[1, 1]
cat("Placebo optimal bandwidth:", round(optimal_bw_placebo, 1), "seconds\n")

data_dec_bw <- data_dec %>%
  filter(running_continuous < optimal_bw_placebo, running_continuous > -optimal_bw_placebo)

model4a <- felm(sentiment_clean ~ running_continuous * treatment * state_owned | country + Topic | 0 | source_domain,
                data = data_dec_bw)

summary(model4a)
cat("\nNote: Non-significant treatment effect suggests parallel trends assumption holds.\n")
```

# Summary Table (Table 2F)

```{r table2f-drop}
rows <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term, ~row1, ~row2, ~row3, ~row4, ~row5, ~row6,
  'State FEs', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X',
  'Source FEs', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-',
  'Topic FEs', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X'
)
attr(rows, 'position') <- c(5, 6, 7)

note_text <- "All standard errors are clustered at the source level. Model 2 uses the optimal bandwidth. Model 3 omits NATO allies. Model 4 omits military-related articles. Model 5 uses only Russian-related articles. Model 6 combines all robustness filters (non-NATO, non-military, Russian-related) with a re-optimized bandwidth. Articles without publication times are dropped."
note_wrapped <- str_wrap(note_text, width = 80)

table_2f <- modelsummary(
  list(model2a, model2a_opt, model2d, model2b, model3a, model3a_opt),
  output = "gt",
  fmt = fmt_significant(2),
  stars = TRUE,
  coef_map = c(
    "treatment" = "Invasion",
    "treatment:state_owned" = "State Owned x Treatment"
  ),
  gof_omit = "BIC|AIC|RMSE|Std.Errors",
  title = "Hypothesis 2: Difference in Discontinuity Analysis (Continuous Running Variable, Drop No-Time Articles)",
  add_rows = rows,
  notes = note_wrapped
)

table_2f
```

## Summary Table: By Topic (Optimal Bandwidth)

```{r table2f-topic-opt-drop}
rows_topic <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term, ~row1, ~row2, ~row3, ~row4, ~row5,
  'State FEs', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X',
  'Source FEs', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-',
  'Topic FEs', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-'
)
attr(rows_topic, 'position') <- c(5, 6, 7)

note_topic_opt <- "All standard errors are clustered at the source level. Each model uses a per-topic re-optimized bandwidth with country fixed effects. Articles without publication times are dropped."
note_topic_opt_wrapped <- str_wrap(note_topic_opt, width = 80)

table_2f_topic_opt <- modelsummary(
  list("Political" = model2a_opt_pol, "Military" = model2a_opt_mil,
       "Economic" = model2a_opt_econ, "Cultural" = model2a_opt_cult, "Other" = model2a_opt_oth),
  output = "gt",
  fmt = fmt_significant(2),
  stars = TRUE,
  coef_map = c(
    "treatment" = "Invasion",
    "treatment:state_owned" = "State Owned x Treatment"
  ),
  gof_omit = "BIC|AIC|RMSE|Std.Errors",
  title = "Hypothesis 2: Diff-in-Disc By Topic (Per-Topic Optimal Bandwidth, Continuous, Drop No-Time Articles)",
  add_rows = rows_topic,
  notes = note_topic_opt_wrapped
)

table_2f_topic_opt
```
